fact: The Addis Ababa Education Bureau had all 555 government schools from pre-primary to grade 12 register students online through the E-School software for the 2017 E.C. school year, replacing paper registration, with 16,000 students registered in the first week; the software was described as in trial (pilot) stage in government schools.
title: በአዲስ አበባ ከተማ ያሉ ሁሉም የመንግስት ትምህርት ቤቶች፤ የተማሪዎቻቸውን ምዝገባ “በኦንላይን” እንዲያካሄዱ ተደረገ
